name: Eiffel Tower to Rambouillet
blurb: Out of Paris past the palace of Versailles, into the forest of Rambouillet.

name: Golden Gate Bridge to Point Reyes
blurb: Across the bridge, through Sausalito and Fairfax, and over the hills to Point Reyes Station.

name: Shibuya Crossing to Kamakura
blurb: From the busiest crossing on earth, down through Yokohama to the Great Buddha.

name: Colosseum to Lake Nemi
blurb: Out of Rome on the old Appian Way, up into the Alban Hills.

name: Table Mountain to Cape Point
blurb: Camps Bay, Hout Bay, Chapman’s Peak and on to the bottom of Africa.

name: Bormio over the Stelvio
blurb: Up the Stelvio’s 40-odd hairpins from Bormio, over the top at 2,758 m, and down to Prato.

name: Alpe d’Huez and Col de Sarenne
blurb: The 21 hairpins from Bourg d’Oisans, then over the Col de Sarenne and back down the valley.

name: Mont Ventoux from Bédoin
blurb: The classic side: through the forest, out onto the moonscape, and down to Malaucène.

name: Central Park to Nyack
blurb: Up Manhattan, over the George Washington Bridge and along the Hudson to Nyack.

name: Sydney Opera House to Palm Beach
blurb: Over the Harbour Bridge and up the Northern Beaches to Palm Beach.

name: Tower Bridge to Box Hill
blurb: Along the Thames, through Richmond Park and out to the Zig Zag road up Box Hill.

name: Brandenburg Gate to Potsdam
blurb: Through the Tiergarten and the Grunewald forest to the palaces of Potsdam.

name: Copacabana to Grumari
blurb: Copacabana, Ipanema and the coast road west to the wild beaches of Grumari.

name: Carmel down Big Sur
blurb: Highway 1 from Carmel over the Bixby Bridge to Nepenthe.

name: Banff to Lake Louise
blurb: The Bow Valley Parkway, past Johnston Canyon, to Lake Louise.

name: Rijksmuseum to Zandvoort
blurb: Out of Amsterdam on the bike paths, through Haarlem to the dunes and the sea.

name: Las Vegas to Red Rock Canyon
blurb: Off the Strip and out to the Red Rock scenic loop.

name: Kyoto to Nara
blurb: From the Golden Pavilion past Fushimi Inari and Uji to the deer of Nara.

name: Paris → Rome
blurb: Burgundy, Lyon, over the Alps at the Col du Mont-Cenis, then Turin, the Ligurian coast and Tuscany.

name: Land’s End → John o’ Groats
blurb: The length of Britain: Cornwall, the Welsh borders, the Lakes, Glencoe and the far north.

name: The Danube: Donaueschingen → Budapest
blurb: The river from its source in the Black Forest, through Ulm, Passau, Vienna and Bratislava to Budapest.

name: Pacific Coast: Seattle → Los Angeles
blurb: The Oregon coast, the redwoods, the Golden Gate, Big Sur and down to the Santa Monica Pier.

name: Route 66: Chicago → Santa Monica
blurb: The Mother Road across eight states, from Lake Michigan to the Pacific.

name: Coast to coast: San Francisco → New York
blurb: Over the Sierra, along America’s loneliest road, across the Rockies and the plains, and into Times Square.

name: Tokyo → Hiroshima
blurb: The old Tōkaidō road past Mount Fuji to Kyoto, then west along the Inland Sea to Hiroshima.
